name: gcoordinator-extension
description: Live 3D preview for gcoordinator toolpaths and G-code, with SpaceMouse support

gcoordinator.port.description: Port number for the gcoordinator preview server

gcoordinator.nozzleSize.description: Nozzle diameter in mm. Controls the cross-section width of the print path visualization (height = nozzleSize / 2).

gcoordinator.pathColor.description: Color of the print path (extrusion) visualization. CSS hex color string (e.g. "#ff8800").

gcoordinator.travelColor.description: Color of the travel move lines. CSS hex color string (e.g. "#0088ff").

gcoordinator.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used for Live Preview. Leave empty to auto-detect (tries ms-python extension, then 'python3', then 'python').

gcoordinator.livePreviewTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to allow a Python script to run during Live Preview before killing it.

scripts.package: npm run build:native && npm run build && vsce package
scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview && npm run build:gcode-webview
scripts.build:native: clang -O2 -Wall -Wextra -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -framework CoreFoundation -o bin/spacemoused native/spacemoused.c
scripts.watch: concurrently "npm run build:ext -- --watch" "npm run build:webview -- --watch" "npm run build:gcode-webview -- --watch"
